passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.1
passages.text: Quam nisi tu dederis, caritura est ipsa, salutem

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.2
passages.text: Mittit Amazonio Cressa puella viro.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.3
passages.text: Perlege, quodcumque est — quid epistula lecta nocebit?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.4
passages.text: Te quoque in hac aliquid quod iuvet esse potest;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.5
passages.text: His arcana notis terra pelagoque feruntur.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.6
passages.text: Inspicit acceptas hostis ab hoste notas.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.7
passages.text: Ter tecum conata loqui ter inutilis haesit

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.8
passages.text: Lingua, ter in primo restitit ore sonus.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.9
passages.text: Qua licet et sequitur, pudor est miscendus amori;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.10
passages.text: Dicere quae puduit, scribere iussit amor.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.11
passages.text: Quidquid Amor iussit, non est contemnere tutum;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.12
passages.text: Regnat et in dominos ius habet ille deos.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.13
passages.text: Ille mihi primo dubitanti scribere dixit:

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.14
passages.text: 'Scribe! dabit victas ferreus ille manus.'

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.15
passages.text: Adsit et, ut nostras avido fovet igne medullas,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.16
passages.text: Figat sic animos in mea vota tuos!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.17
passages.text: Non ego nequitia socialia foedera rumpam;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.18
passages.text: Fama — velim quaeras — crimine nostra vacat.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.19
passages.text: Venit amor gravius, quo serius — urimur intus;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.20
passages.text: Urimur, et caecum pectora vulnus habent.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.21
passages.text: Scilicet ut teneros laedunt iuga prima iuvencos,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.22
passages.text: Frenaque vix patitur de grege captus equus,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.23
passages.text: Sic male vixque subit primos rude pectus amores,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.24
passages.text: Sarcinaque haec animo non sedet apta meo.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.25
passages.text: Ars fit, ubi a teneris crimen condiscitur annis;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.26
passages.text: Cui venit exacto tempore, peius amat.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.27
passages.text: Tu nova servatae capies libamina famae,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.28
passages.text: Et pariter nostrum fiet uterque nocens.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.29
passages.text: Est aliquid, plenis pomaria carpere ramis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.30
passages.text: Et tenui primam delegere ungue rosam.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.31
passages.text: Si tamen ille prior, quo me sine crimine gessi,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.32
passages.text: Candor ab insolita labe notandus erat,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.33
passages.text: At bene successit, digno quod adurimur igni;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.34
passages.text: Peius adulterio turpis adulter obest.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.35
passages.text: Si mihi concedat Iuno fratremque virumque,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.36
passages.text: Hippolytum videor praepositura Iovi!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.37
passages.text: Iam quoque — vix credes — ignotas mittor in artes;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.38
passages.text: Est mihi per saevas impetus ire feras.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.39
passages.text: Iam mihi prima dea est arcu praesignis adunco

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.40
passages.text: Delia; iudicium subsequor ipsa tuum.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.41
passages.text: In nemus ire libet pressisque in retia cervis

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.42
passages.text: Hortari celeris per iuga summa canes,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.43
passages.text: Aut tremulum excusso iaculum vibrare lacerto,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.44
passages.text: Aut in graminea ponere corpus humo.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.45
passages.text: Saepe iuvat versare leves in pulvere currus

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.46
passages.text: Torquentem frenis ora fugacis equi;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.47
passages.text: Nunc feror, ut Bacchi furiis Eleleides actae,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.48
passages.text: Quaeque sub Idaeo tympana colle movent,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.49
passages.text: Aut quas semideae Dryades Faunique bicornes

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.50
passages.text: Numine contactas attonuere suo.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.51
passages.text: Namque mihi referunt, cum se furor ille remisit,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.52
passages.text: Omnia; me tacitam conscius urit amor.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.53
passages.text: Forsitan hunc generis fato reddamus amorem,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.54
passages.text: Et Venus ex tota gente tributa petat.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.55
passages.text: Iuppiter Europen — prima est ea gentis origo —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.56
passages.text: Dilexit, tauro dissimulante deum.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.57
passages.text: Pasiphae mater, decepto subdita tauro,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.58
passages.text: Enixa est utero crimen onusque suo.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.59
passages.text: Perfidus Aegides, ducentia fila secutus,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.60
passages.text: Curva meae fugit tecta sororis ope.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.61
passages.text: En, ego nunc, ne forte parum Minoia credar,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.62
passages.text: In socias leges ultima gentis eo!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.63
passages.text: Hoc quoque fatale est: placuit domus una duabus;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.64
passages.text: Me tua forma capit, capta parente soror.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.65
passages.text: Thesides Theseusque duas rapuere sorores —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.66
passages.text: Ponite de nostra bina tropaea domo!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.67
passages.text: Tempore quo nobis inita est Cerealis Eleusin,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.68
passages.text: Gnosia me vellem detinuisset humus!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.69
passages.text: Tunc mihi praecipue (nec non tamen ante placebas)

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.70
passages.text: Acer in extremis ossibus haesit amor.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.71
passages.text: Candida vestis erat, praecincti flore capilli,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.72
passages.text: Flava verecundus tinxerat ora rubor,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.73
passages.text: Quemque vocant aliae vultum rigidumque trucemque,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.74
passages.text: Pro rigido Phaedra iudice fortis erat.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.75
passages.text: Sint procul a nobis iuvenes ut femina compti! —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.76
passages.text: Fine coli modico forma virilis amat.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.77
passages.text: Te tuus iste rigor positique sine arte capilli

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.78
passages.text: Et levis egregio pulvis in ore decet.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.79
passages.text: Sive ferocis equi luctantia colla recurvas,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.80
passages.text: Exiguo flexos miror in orbe pedes;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.81
passages.text: Seu lentum valido torques hastile lacerto,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.82
passages.text: Ora ferox in se versa lacertus habet,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.83
passages.text: Sive tenes lato venabula cornea ferro.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.84
passages.text: Denique nostra iuvat lumina, quidquid agis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.85
passages.text: Tu modo duritiam silvis depone iugosis;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.86
passages.text: Non sum militia digna perire tua.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.87
passages.text: Quid iuvat incinctae studia exercere Dianae,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.88
passages.text: Et Veneri numeros eripuisse suos?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.89
passages.text: Quod caret alterna requie, durabile non est;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.90
passages.text: Haec reparat vires fessaque membra novat.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.91
passages.text: Arcus — et arma tuae tibi sunt imitanda Dianae —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.92
passages.text: Si numquam cesses tendere, mollis erit.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.93
passages.text: Clarus erat silvis Cephalus, multaeque per herbas

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.94
passages.text: Conciderant illo percutiente ferae;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.95
passages.text: Nec tamen Aurorae male se praebebat amandum.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.96
passages.text: Ibat ad hunc sapiens a sene diva viro.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.97
passages.text: Saepe sub ilicibus Venerem Cinyraque creatum

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.98
passages.text: Sustinuit positos quaelibet herba duos.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.99
passages.text: Arsit et Oenides in Maenalia Atalanta;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.100
passages.text: Illa ferae spolium pignus amoris habet.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.101
passages.text: Nos quoque quam primum turba numeremur in ista!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.102
passages.text: Si Venerem tollas, rustica silva tua est.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.103
passages.text: Ipsa comes veniam, nec me latebrosa movebunt

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.104
passages.text: Saxa neque obliquo dente timendus aper.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.105
passages.text: Aequora bina suis obpugnant fluctibus isthmon,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.106
passages.text: Et tenuis tellus audit utrumque mare.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.107
passages.text: Hic tecum Troezena colam, Pittheia regna;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.108
passages.text: Iam nunc est patria carior illa mea.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.109
passages.text: Tempore abest aberitque diu Neptunius heros;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.110
passages.text: Illum Pirithoi detinet ora sui.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.111
passages.text: Praeposuit Theseus — nisi si manifesta negamus —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.112
passages.text: Pirithoum Phaedrae Pirithoumque tibi.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.113
passages.text: Sola nec haec ad nos iniuria venit ab illo;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.114
passages.text: In magnis laesi rebus uterque sumus.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.115
passages.text: Ossa mei fratris clava perfracta trinodi

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.116
passages.text: Sparsit humi; soror est praeda relicta feris.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.117
passages.text: Prima securigeras inter virtute puellas

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.118
passages.text: Te peperit, nati digna vigore parens;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.119
passages.text: Si quaeras, ubi sit — Theseus latus ense peregit,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.120
passages.text: Nec tanto mater pignore tuta fuit.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.121
passages.text: At ne nupta quidem taedaque accepta iugali —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.122
passages.text: Cur, nisi ne caperes regna paterna nothus?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.123
passages.text: Addidit et fratres ex me tibi, quos tamen omnis

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.124
passages.text: Non ego tollendi causa, sed ille fuit.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.125
passages.text: O utinam nocitura tibi, pulcherrime rerum,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.126
passages.text: In medio nisu viscera rupta forent!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.127
passages.text: I nunc, sic meriti lectum reverere parentis —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.128
passages.text: Quem fugit et factis abdicat ipse suis!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.129
passages.text: Nec, quia privigno videar coitura noverca,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.130
passages.text: Terruerint animos nomina vana tuos.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.131
passages.text: Ista vetus pietas, aevo moritura futuro,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.132
passages.text: Rustica Saturno regna tenente fuit.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.133
passages.text: Iuppiter esse pium statuit, quodcumque iuvaret,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.134
passages.text: Et fas omne facit fratre marita soror.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.135
passages.text: Illa coit firma generis iunctura catena,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.136
passages.text: Inposuit nodos cui Venus ipsa suos.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.137
passages.text: Nec labor est celare, licet peccemus, amorem.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.138
passages.text: Cognato poterit nomine culpa tegi.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.139
passages.text: Viderit amplexos aliquis, laudabimur ambo;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.140
passages.text: Dicar privigno fida noverca meo.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.141
passages.text: Non tibi per tenebras duri reseranda mariti

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.142
passages.text: Ianua, non custos decipiendus erit;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.143
passages.text: Ut tenuit domus una duos, domus una tenebit;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.144
passages.text: Oscula aperta dabas, oscula aperta dabis;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.145
passages.text: Tutus eris mecum laudemque merebere culpa,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.146
passages.text: Tu licet in lecto conspiciare meo.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.147
passages.text: Tolle moras tantum properataque foedera iunge —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.148
passages.text: Qui mihi nunc saevit, sic tibi parcat Amor!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.149
passages.text: Non ego dedignor supplex humilisque precari.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.150
passages.text: Heu! ubi nunc fastus altaque verba iacent?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.151
passages.text: Et pugnare diu nec me submittere culpae

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.152
passages.text: Certa fui — certi siquid haberet amor;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.153
passages.text: Victa precor genibusque tuis regalia tendo

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.154
passages.text: Bracchia! quid deceat, non videt ullus amans.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.155
passages.text: Depudui, profugusque pudor sua signa reliquit.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.156
passages.text: Da veniam fasse duraque corda doma!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.157
passages.text: Quod mihi sit genitor, qui possidet aequora, Minos,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.158
passages.text: Quod veniant proavi fulmina torta manu,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.159
passages.text: Quod sit avus radiis frontem vallatus acutis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.160
passages.text: Purpureo tepidum qui movet axe diem —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.161
passages.text: Nobilitas sub amore iacet! miserere priorum

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.162
passages.text: Et, mihi si non vis parcere, parce meis!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.163
passages.text: Est mihi dotalis tellus Iovis insula, Crete —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.164
passages.text: Serviat Hippolyto regia tota meo!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.165
passages.text: Flecte, ferox, animos! potuit corrumpere taurum

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.166
passages.text: Mater; eris tauro saevior ipse truci?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.167
passages.text: Per Venerem, parcas, oro, quae plurima mecum est!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.168
passages.text: Sic numquam, quae te spernere possit, ames;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.169
passages.text: Sic tibi secretis agilis dea saltibus adsit,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.170
passages.text: Silvaque perdendas praebeat alta feras;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.171
passages.text: Sic faveant Satyri montanaque numina Panes,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.172
passages.text: Et cadat adversa cuspide fossus aper;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.173
passages.text: Sic tibi dent Nymphae, quamvis odisse puellas

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.174
passages.text: Diceris, arentem quae levet unda sitim!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.175
passages.text: Addimus his precibus lacrimas quoque; verba precantis

passages.label: Ov. Her. 4.176
passages.text: Qui legis, et lacrimas finge videre meas!
